SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category, a.tags, a.author_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_time, IFNULL(b.number,0) AS views, IFNULL(c.number,0) AS comments, IFNULL(d.number,0) AS likes, ((IFNULL(b.number,0) + ( IFNULL(c.number,0) * 5 ) + (IFNULL(d.number,0) * 10)) / POWER(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, a.create_time, NOW()) + 2, 1.5)) AS score FROM t_articles a LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id,COUNT(id) AS number FROM t_post_view GROUP BY post_id) b ON a.id = b.post_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id,COUNT(id) AS number FROM t_comment GROUP BY post_id) c ON a.id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id,COUNT(id) AS number FROM t_post_likes GROUP BY post_id ) d ON a.id = d.post_id
a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.category LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.category},'%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_post_tag_relation ptr INNER JOIN t_tags t ON ptr.tag_id = t.id WHERE ptr.post_id = a.id AND t.tags_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.tags}, '%') )
ORDER BY
(a.author_id = #{param.authorId}) DESC, a.update_time DESC, a.create_time DESC,
score DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.update_time DESC,

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_articles a
a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.category LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.category},'%')

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category, a.tags, a.views, a.comments, a.likes, a.author_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.is_deleted, b.category_name FROM t_articles a LEFT JOIN t_articles_category b ON a.category = b.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `day`, COUNT( a.id ) AS `count` FROM t_articles a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND YEAR ( create_time ) = #{searchYear} GROUP BY `day` ORDER BY `day`
